title: Affect and Motivation
purpose: A proposed course in the Corniversity catalogue (Optional elective). Emotional and motivational influences on learning, decision-making, effort allocation and behaviour, with candidate explanations compared against evidence; not productivity advice and not biological slogans.
description: Proposed course: Affect and Motivation. Central question: How do emotional and motivational states shape learning, decisions, effort and behaviour? Source verification and syllabus design have not been completed, so no teaching material exists yet. You may register interest or ask the director about it; nothing is prepared on request.

centralQuestion: How do emotional and motivational states shape learning, decisions, effort and behaviour?
prerequisiteGuidance: Cognitive psychology foundations (COG-101) and the learning and decision-making block (MBI-06) help; the choice-model unit of COG-260 is a useful bridge for effort and value models.
preparationPath: Resolve a primary source on effort allocation and one on affective influences on choice; prepare a first unit around comparing explanations of an effort-allocation result.
plannedActivities: Compare explanations of an effort-allocation result and identify an experiment or observation that could distinguish them.
